plan.notes: AAS in Early Childhood Education 'Course Sequence by Term' as published in the official 2026-2027 MCC pathway map (Academic Plan Code 3186), retrieved 2026-10-01. The map publishes two pacing variants (full-time Terms 1-4 and part-time Terms 1-8); this seed follows the full-time variant. Sequenced sum = 71 (18+18+16+19) using maximum printed credit values for range cells, per the range convention; the catalog prints Total Credits Required 60-74. Combo-course rows (printed as '(A and B) or C') are seeded as choice slots with the first-listed combo option, documented in choice_note.
